subject: legend for multiple layers with different datasets

messages.author: 6d020fc5d7c9ee0a
messages.subject: legend for multiple layers with different datasets
parts:
Hi,

I have done some digging but cannot seem to find a solution to adding a legend when I am combining multiple layers onto a base ggplot plot.  I would like to add a legend for different line types used in geom_line() for each layer.  After making an initial ggplot object, I am calling the following function below, multiple times (with different data sets) to add lines on top of the original plot.  Rather than having to make one big data frame, is there a way to add a legend at the end to identify each linetype?   Below is the function that is getting called multiple times to add lines to the plot.

Thanks,
Colin


KM <- function(id, samp, n_iter=NULL, xlim, ylim, quantiles=c(.05, .5, .95), x_logscale=T, n=30, verbose=F,
                    pi.free=T, mu1.free=F, sigma1.free=F, mu2.free=T, sigma2.free=T, linetp="dashed", colline="black", colband="red"){
  total_iter <- length(samp$lp__)
  iter <- floor(total_iter/n_iter) * 1:n_iter
  
  if(x_logscale){
    x <- exp(seq(log(xlim[1]), log(xlim[2]), length.out=n))
  } else{
    x <- seq(xlim[1], xlim[2], length.out=n)
  }
  
  band <- data.frame(x=x) %>%
    ddply(.(x), function(g){
      Fp <- sapply(iter, function(i) {
        1 -  (1 - exp(samp$log_pi[i+pi.free*total_iter*(id-1)]) * 
                my_pweibull(g$x, samp$mu1[i+mu1.free*total_iter*(id-1)], samp$sigma1[i+sigma1.free*total_iter*(id-1)])) *
          (1 - my_pweibull(g$x, samp$mu2[i+mu2.free*total_iter*(id-1)], samp$sigma2[i+sigma2.free*total_iter*(id-1)]))
      })
      q <- quantile(Fp, quantiles)
      data.frame(y = q[2], lower = max(ylim[1],q[1]), upper = min(ylim[2],q[3]))
    })
  if(verbose) print(band)
  list(ptws_ci = geom_ribbon(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x=x, ymin=lower, ymax=upper), fill=colband, alpha=.2),
       ptws_est = geom_line(data= band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x=x, y=y), linetype=linetp, color=colline))
}

messages.subject: Re: legend for multiple layers with different datasets
parts:
Hi,

Please disregard the question; I think I have it figured out using aes_ and passing a string for each layer in the argument function (num).
list(ptws_ci = geom_ribbon(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x=x, ymin=lower, ymax=upper), fill=colband, alpha=.2),

ptws_est = geom_line(data= band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes_(x=substitute(x), y=substitute(y), colour=num, linetype=num)))

~Colin
